name: zcode-supervisor
description: Delegate bounded development tasks from Codex to a local ZCode installation and review retained execution evidence.

interface.shortDescription: 让 Codex 委派 ZCode 并核对交付证据
interface.longDescription: Local macOS delegation through the reviewed ZCode app-server bridge. Includes the supervisor runtime and a discoverable workflow skill. Requires Python 3.11+, Node.js and a separately installed, signed-in, supported ZCode build.
defaultPrompt: 使用 ZCode Supervisor 检查本机环境，然后把这个有明确范围的开发任务委派给 ZCode。
